"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Senate bill would prevent any possibility of enacting Medicare for All.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Past Republican administrations claimed that tax cuts to corporations will stimulate the economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The claim is that businesses will have more after-tax money, make new investments, hire more workers, and pay them more, thus propelling an economic boom.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump ran on a program based on the claim that tax cuts stimulate the economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The “trickle down” philosophy has never yielded a significant increase in investment but has led to major gains in corporate profits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA opposes taxing the 99% to give to the 1%.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will join the “Not One Penny.org” efforts to insure that the Trump tax cuts are defeated.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Any tax reform must ease the tax burden that falls hardest on the working class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
